image_description: A close-up, high-resolution photograph of a wood rabbit (cottontail) situated in grassy vegetation. The rabbit is facing slightly to the right, with its head and upper torso clearly visible. It has brown and grey fur, large dark eyes, and upright ears. A blade of grass obscures part of the mouth area.
